headline_hook: Anthropic Ships a Plugin Ecosystem While Engineers Write Their Own Survival Guide
preview_topics: why AI still won't replace engineers

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The developer who spent a week converting to Fable's capabilities — then lost access overnight — writes the strongest case yet for why AI augments rather than replaces engineering judgment. His timing makes the argument land harder than any think piece could: you don't get to dismiss 'AI won't take your job' when the guy saying it just lost his favorite tool and is more productive, not less, for understanding why.

model_literacy.relevance: Rio de Janeiro's '397B homegrown LLM' turned out to be a merge of existing open-weight models. Understanding merge techniques — how SLERP interpolates weights, how TIES resolves parameter conflicts — explains both why merging is a legitimate research technique and why calling the result 'homegrown' is misleading. As open models proliferate, provenance verification becomes as important as benchmark scores.
